schoolDivisionId.name: Food Technology
schoolDivisionId.about: In a world facing unprecedented population growth and climate volatility, the scope of Food Technology extends far beyond simple processing. It is the critical bridge between agricultural production and human health. Our department recognizes Food Technologists as the architects of global health—professionals who engineer functional foods, ensure the highest standards of safety, and optimize the nutritional value of what the world eats. The food industry remains one of the largest and most resilient economic sectors globally. Our department is committed to meeting this immense industry capacity by producing skilled professionals who are ready to lead in multinational corporations, reputed research & development facilities, and entrepreneurial ventures. Throughout their studies, students are exposed to a wide range of opportunities including international workshops, industry-led internships, and intensive in-plant training in modern pilot plants. Our curriculum is meticulously designed to merge the fundamental principles of Biological Sciences with Advanced Engineering, preparing students to address the complex challenges of the 21st-century food supply chain.

name: 3D Printing and Functional Fabrication: Bridging Healthcare, Pharma and Food Innovation
description: A two-day international seminar and hands-on workshop on 3D printing covering applications in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, and food innovation. The event included expert lectures on personalized food printing, hydrogels, bioprinting, regenerative medicine, and drug delivery systems. Participants also received practical training using advanced 3D bioprinting equipment, gaining valuable real-time experience and technical skills.
co_ordinator: Dr. M. Maria Leena,  Dr. Indumathi C,  Dr. U Gnana Moorthy Easwaran, & Dr. R. Santhosh

The Division of Chemistry was established in September 2021 and has emerged as a hub for academic excellence. The division is guided by a team of dedicated faculty members, each of whom has successfully completed their Ph.D. programs, the department has swiftly transformed into a nucleus for pioneering research, publications, and impactful events. As the Division of Chemistry continues to chart new territories in the realm of scientific inquiry, its faculty members remain steadfast in their commitment to excellence, innovation, and scholarly pursuits. Through their dedication to research, mentorship, and academic engagement, they embody the spirit of discovery that defines the department's ethos. With a vibrant community of scholars, the department is poised to make significant contributions to the field of chemistry and inspire future generations of scientists.

The diverse research interests of our faculty members span into various subfields of chemistry such as Supramolecular Chemistry, Sensors, Solar Cells, Polymer Chemistry, Computational, Bio-Inorganic chemistry, Photophysical Studies of Biomolecules & Nanomaterials for energy, bio-medical and environmental applications. Each faculty member, driven by a passion for discovery, plays a pivotal role in shaping the academic landscape of the chemistry division. They have obtained guideship and mentor research scholars. Their dedication for advancing the frontiers of knowledge is reflected in their impressive publications of research articles in peer-reviewed journals, book chapters, and books. These contributions demonstrate the commitment of the division of Chemistry to push the boundaries of science.
